user.title: Welcome to Zählerfreunde
user.description:
This integration connects your Home Assistant instance to the Zählerfreunde platform.

During the setup, you will:
1. **Select a device category** (e.g. inverter, electricity meter, battery).
2. **Optionally select the Home Assistant device** that belongs to this category (skip to allow any entity).
3. **Map entities** to their corresponding sensor roles.
4. **Authorize the connection** by briefly signing in on the Zählerfreunde website.

Click **Submit** to get started.

select_category.title: What would you like to add?
select_category.description: Please select the type of device you would like to add.

select_device.title: Which device would you like to add?
select_device.description: Optionally select the device you would like to add. If you skip this step, all entities will be available for mapping.

select_entities.title: What is being measured?
select_entities.description: Select which entities should be sent to Zählerfreunde.

map_battery_mode.title: Map battery modes
map_battery_mode.description: Select which option on `{entity_id}` corresponds to each mode.

map_heat_pump_mode.title: Map heat pump modes
map_heat_pump_mode.description: Select which option on `{entity_id}` corresponds to each mode.
